_comment: Where each game keeps its top score, for the arcade profiles high-score screen (docs/arcade-profiles.md). file: the game's hiscore save in mame2003-plus's hi folder (/home/pi/RetroPie/BIOS/mame2003-plus/hi). offset/length: the bytes of the top score in it; mame2003-plus saves the memory regions listed for the game in its hiscore.dat back to back, so the offset is the length of the regions before the top score's. encoding: bcd-le (two digits a byte, lowest first) or tiles-le (one digit a byte, 0-9, lowest first, blank is 0x24). Worked out from hiscore.dat; not yet checked against real saves on the cabinet.
